newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil rail concession sold for 18.51 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil rail concession sold for 18.51 mln reais.

text.p: A 30-year concession to run the Tereza Cristina section of Brazil's federal railway network was sold to a consortium led by Brazil's Interfinance Bank for 18.51 million reais, a Rio stock exchange official said.
The price was 11.33 percent above the minimum price, which was set at 16.6 million reais.
The winning consortium also included Gemon Geral de Engenaria e Montagens and Santa Lucia Agroindustria e Comercio.
The 164-kilometer railway branch links Criciuma in the southern state of Santa Catarina with the port of Imbituba.

The winning consortium must make an initial payment of 1.662 million reais plus the difference between the base and the auction price followed by another 112 instalments of 600,000 reais to be paid on a quarterly basis.
Tereza Cristina is the fourth of six federal railway sections to be privatised.
The southern branch of the rail network is due to be privatised December 13 and no date has been set yet for the northeastern section.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
